text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, in the middle of running errands――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
That's one thing sorted out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing Symboli Rudolf emerge from a nearby shop, I called out to her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well now, what a coincidence.
Are you out running errands or something?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I just finished ordering the towels
and was about to head to my next stop.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I was thinking of expanding the student council's supply of rental items.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The forecast calls for rough weather throughout next week. More students will likely come looking to borrow one. We must prepare accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Once we finish ordering rain gear like umbrellas after this,
we'll be fully prepared for any scenario.
choice_data_list: Thanks, now rainy days won't be a problem.
Thanks, now we won't have to worry on rainy days.
Good work. Must be tough working so hard for the academy.
Good work. Must be tough working so hard for the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please, feel free to pour your heart into it.
After all, that is why I prepared this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Rainy days or not, I want to create an environment
where everyone at the academy can focus single-mindedly on their dreams.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you have any requests,
please don't hesitate to speak up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No need for thanks. I had to go into town on student council business anyway, so it was on my way.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I bear the responsibility of improving
everyone's training environment. It's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Alright, once the ordering's done, I also want to check the course drainage... Better hurry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I felt there was much to learn from Symboli Rudolf's sense of responsibility and boundless vitality.
